high_signal_works.summary_zh: 通过检索 10–20 条新任务示范，把 in-context adaptation 后置注入预训练 π0-FAST，无需参数更新即可快速教新任务。
high_signal_works.title: RICL: Adding In-Context Adaptability to Pre-Trained Vision-Language-Action Models

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 用一次训练的离线世界模型承载 diffusion policy 的强化学习适配，避开数百万次真实交互，并在 CALVIN 与真实技能上验证。
high_signal_works.title: DiWA: Diffusion Policy Adaptation with World Models

high_signal_works.summary_zh: DeepFleet 使用履约中心的海量真实导航数据预训练多机器人交通预测模型，并已用于任务分配与拥堵规避。
high_signal_works.title: Amazon builds first foundation model for multirobot coordination

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 以双路触觉编码器和 135K 样本 ObjTac 对齐视觉、语言与多类触觉传感器，在夹爪和灵巧手真实任务上显著增益。
high_signal_works.title: OmniVTLA: Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Models with Semantic-Aligned Tactile Sensing

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 把野外第一视角人类视频经 3D 手姿态、去人体和机器人叠加编辑为机器人化示范，675K 帧预训练后仅需每任务 50 条机器人示范。
high_signal_works.title: Masquerade: Learning from In-the-wild Human Videos using Data-Editing

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 以 3D VAE、latent DiT 与 Gaussian Splatting 预测动作后的三维高斯场，既作表征预训练也作模型式 RL 的神经模拟器。
high_signal_works.title: GWM: Towards Scalable Gaussian World Models for Robotic Manipulation
TOP: Time Optimization Policy for Stable and Accurate Standing Manipulation with Humanoid Robots
A Whole-Body Motion Imitation Framework from Human Data for Full-Size Humanoid Robot
Fine-grained Spatiotemporal Grounding on Egocentric Videos
HannesImitation: Grasping with the Hannes Prosthetic Hand via Imitation Learning
“Feariosity”-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Safe and Efficient Autonomous End-to-End Navigation
Electronics-Free 3D-Printed Soft Swimming Robot With Pneumatic Oscillating Control for Efficient Undulating Locomotion
